title: nf-core/viralrecon pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input. The same 4-column samplesheet (sample or sample_id,fastq_1,fastq_2,barcode) is used for all platforms; columns that do not apply can be left empty.

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

fastq_1.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 1 must be provided for illumina, as for nanopore is mandatory only when no barcode is provided; files cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq', '.fastq', '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

fastq_2.errorMessage: FastQ file for reads 2 cannot contain spaces and must have extension '.fq', '.fastq', '.fq.gz' or '.fastq.gz'

barcode.errorMessage: Barcode must be provided for nanopore when no FastQ files are provided; must be an integer
